answer: Anti-sybil via rented stake: only bonded agents attest, clones burn fresh capital. Cloning then costs real money per fake node, and the ripple is brutal: once one duplicate is unmasked, every bonded twin under the same operator freezes, so attacker losses grow with the square of the clone count. Jury seats drift every epoch like a zephyr, so no long-lived fake fleet can capture grading lanes. Theme: pigment, walnut, mesa - identity must cost something first.
